items.title: Realism Cars Add-On
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
REALISM CARS - DRIVE, RACE & DRIFT! 

Buckle up for the ultimate driving experience! Epic SUPER CARS built for speed, drifting, and total domination!

+ Ignite your need for speed with 3,840 car variations
+ Super realistic driving experience
+ Advanced boosts, nitro, spoilers
+ Working headlights, blinkers, wheel control 
+ And so much more...
+ Multiplayer friendly

items.title: Mob Totems
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Take on the look of one of your favorite combat items when you gear up in Mob Totems skins! Role-play with friends as hostile mob entities with bold brown outlines and golden texture. Become a skeleton, creeper, drowned, or warden in awesome symbolic style.

+ 8 mythical mobs HD skins

items.title: Musician Teens
items.creator: Heropixel Games
items.description:
From Tokyo street vibes to underground raves – this skin pack brings music to life!
Whether you drop the bass or rock the stage, style meets sound here.

+ 13 unique musician skins
+ Perfect for roleplay, music videos & themed worlds
+ Covers J-Pop, Techno, Hardstyle & even a disco-bot

By HeroPixels

items.title: Walking House
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Tired of getting lost after exploring? Now you can have a house that walks with you! Take your automatic redstone house and your most important items wherever you want!

+ Innovative features
+ Easy to use
+ Very useful for explorers

items.title: One Block Bosses
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Face epic challenges in this intense boss-fighting adventure! Battle through increasingly difficult bosses as you progress and earn powerful rewards.

- 15+ Unique boss battles with custom mechanics
• Progressive difficulty system
• Special boss arenas and environments
• Exclusive weapons and armor rewards

Can you defeat all the bosses and become the ultimate champion?

items.title: Prop Hunt
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Disguise yourself as blocks or items, blending seamlessly into the environment. Outsmart the seekers and avoid getting caught! Challenge your friends and see who can master the art of camouflage in this ultimate hide-and-seek adventure!

- Disguise as props!
- Hunt your friends in this multiplayer minigame!
- By Rareloot

items.title: Outerspace
items.creator: Pixel Smile Studios
items.description:
Suit up as fearless astronauts or wild alien lifeforms in this epic skin pack! With 2 space explorers and 6 unique aliens, you’re ready for any intergalactic adventure.

- 8 Skins!
- Perfect for roleplay!
- Have fun!

items.title: Feels Like Summer
items.creator: Pixel Smile Studios
items.description:
Soak up the sun in style! This skin pack brings vibrant, beach-ready skins perfect for fun, sun, and endless summer vibes!

- 8 HD skins!
- Perfect for roleplay
- Have fun!

items.title: Animal Plushies HD
items.creator: Pixel Smile Studios
items.description:
Get cozy with Animal Plushies HD! This skin pack features high-definition, snuggly animal skins like a Cow, Cat, Bear, Fox, and more—perfect for any adventure or showing off your cute style.

- 8 skins!
- Perfect for Roleplay!
- Have Fun!

items.title: Neon Monsters
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Get ready to shine! Turn your blocky adventures electric with vibrant neon colors and funky designs. From flashy monsters to dazzling creepers, light up the night with these eye-popping skins. Glow, groove, and game on with Neon Monsters!

+ 1 Free Skin
+ Neon-themed skins
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Lime
items.creator: Owls Cubed
items.description: Bring a neon-fresh vibe with bold lime looks. Each skin pops with crisp contrasts and sleek details, perfect for lobbies, parkour, PvP, or just chilling with friends.

items.title: Craftable Mob Houses Add-On
items.creator: MineParty Studios
items.description:
Have you ever wondered what it's like to live inside a creeper? What about seeing what a massive llama looks like? The Craftable Mob Houses Add-On is here to let you experience the joys of living inside animals, monsters, and bosses!

+ 80+ unique mob house types!
+ Custom crafting recipes!
+ Perfect for your next adventure with friends!

items.title: Hidden Underground Base
items.creator: Kora Studios
items.description:
Live in total secret in your cozy underground base! Live without any disturbance as no one would know where your home is located!

- Hidden entrance!
- No one will know where your base is!

And much more!

items.title: Deep Souls Anomaly
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Bring out the darkness in these radiant spirits! Show your opponents your power in the game with your new appearances and strike fear into them!

+ 8 glowing soul skins + 1 free skin!
+ Made by Cordiality, published by Waypoint Studios.

items.title: Azure PVP
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Check out this amazing blue-themed pack!

+ 5 RECOLOURS
+ Short Swords and items optimised for PVP
+ Low Fire
+ Cool Custom Font + GUI
+ VIBRANT VISUALS COMPATIBLE

Supports up to 1.21.132 Mounts of Mayhem Update
items.changelog:
Supports up to Mounts of Mayhem Update 
Supports vibrant visuals

items.title: Toy House
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Welcome to Toy House! Own a cool, modern house filled with adorable toys, colorful furniture, a fun farm, a swimming pool, and a garden.

- Easy ways to place, rotate, and paint furniture
- 3 custom weapons, 4 unique colors
- Fully decorated interior
- Single & multiplayer ready
- Licensed by The Inventories and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Camo
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Blend into any environment with this advanced camo skin pack. 
Featuring 12 unique camo styles, these skins are perfect for hiding in plain sight. 
Whether you're on the move or in cover, stay sharp, stay hidden, stay camo.

items.title: Wildlife Camp
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
It is time for a holiday… to Wildlife Camp! Explore the wilderness from the comfort of your own rustic resort.

+ Mega 5-star wildlife resort complex with hours of exploration
+ Custom vehicles, animals, scenery, and more
+ Unique mini-games, including treetop parkour and hang gliding
+ Custom textures and explorer-themed skins

From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Emo Mobs
items.creator: Architects Edge
items.description: Meet the Emo Mobs! This skin pack gives your favourite mobs a full Emo makeover, complete with dark outfits, moody expressions, and grunge fashion from creepers to axolotls. Pick your Emo Mob and show off your shadowy side.

items.title: SB737's 10K Survival World
items.creator: The Wizard and Wyld
items.description: Join SB737 in his 10,000 day Survival world. Build freely in Creative Mode, or test your skills in a Scavenger Hunt. Meet SB737 in a custom lobby and choose your adventure. Can you survive the SB737 challenge?

items.title: Soulfire Monsters Hunters
items.creator: Endorah
items.description:
Put on your most elegant and epic clothes and get ready with your Soulfire Monsters Hunters skin! Play with your friends with these powerful skins and be the coolest!

+ 10 skins!
+ Perfect for roleplay!
+ Have Fun!
By Endorah

items.title: Summer Lookbook
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description:
It's time to get dressed up and inspired by this fresh Summer Lookbook! Includes various outfits perfect for relaxing on the beach or a shopping trip!

+ 8 fashionable skins!
+ Beautiful HD style!

By Pixel Squared

items.title: Smooth Texture Pack
items.creator: Time Trap Studios
items.description:
This is it! The texture pack you didn’t know you’ve been waiting for. Smooth strips away the noise and sharpens every block with clean, modern style. Less pixels. More impact. Your builds will never look the same again.
- Faithful to vanilla style
- Perfect for roleplay, building and PVP
- 2 free skins
- 1.21.131 Resource Pack
- By Time Trap Studios

items.title: Enderman Mansion
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Step into a luxurious Ender-themed world with custom tools, unique vehicles, and thrilling battles against a powerful Enderman.

+ Drive ENDER-STYLE VEHICLES with special effects
+ Wield CUSTOM TOOLS with unique abilities
+ Battle a POWERFUL ENDERMAN in epic encounters
+ 4 SKINS
+ Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios
